Name: Time Knife
Description: A magical blade of disruptive energy sails toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 slashing damage plus force damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
At Higher Levels: The spell creates additional blades when you reach higher levels: two blades at 5th level, three blades at 11th level, and four blades at 17th level. You can direct the blades at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each blade.
